title: Make kb-tests-windows start on its own for tool changes
goal: kb-tests-windows's rule for tool changes has when: on_success and allow_failure: true instead of when: manual, and kb/_self/git.md says the Windows job starts on its own.

run: import re,pathlib;t=pathlib.Path('.gitlab-ci.yml').read_text(encoding='utf-8');b=re.search(r'(?ms)^kb-tests-windows:\n.*?(?=^\S)',t).group(0);r=b.split('rules:',1)[1];assert 'when: manual' not in r and 'when: on_success' in r and 'allow_failure: true' in r,r
